figurative_meaning_en: The dedicated members or backbone of an organization
example_sentences_in_bangla: দলের ক্যাডাররা নির্বাচনে সক্রিয় ভূমিকা পালন করেছে।
সংগঠনের শক্তিশালী ক্যাডার ছাড়া কোনো আন্দোলন সফল হয় না।
example_sentences_in_english: The party's cadre played an active role in the elections.
No movement succeeds without a strong organizational cadre.
history: The term 'cadre' originates from French military usage and was adopted in Marxist-Leninist politics to refer to trained revolutionary members, popularized in Bengali political discourse through communist and leftist movements in India and Bangladesh.
note: Borrowed term from English/French, commonly used in political contexts in Bengali.
